decisions.reason: Because Product A disappeared from the website already by 2019 while similar adjacent plugins were also pruned quickly, its results likely fell below the firm's aspiration level and a German specialist firm with alternative development opportunities would reallocate those resources.

Because Product B progressed from a simple mention in 2018 to a dedicated page in 2019, it likely met or exceeded aspiration levels, and with industry growth and some organizational slack the firm would continue supporting a product that fits its core shop-integration capabilities.
